title: Conditional Graph Diffusion for Negotiation Support: Overcoming Discrete Infeasibility and Preference Elicitation Gaps
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'normative compliance' in negotiation support systems, specifically benchmarking and evaluating criteria such as fairness, equitability, and individual rationality. These are core components of distributive justice and normative ethics as applied to automated decision-making and multi-agent systems.
